lines.t: The mountains crumble, but you stand still
The oceans roar, yet you're my will
In the storm
I hear your song
Your light, it cuts the night
Your hand, it holds me tight
Your love is stronger than anything
Your name invades the heavens sing
Your who soar, the world will cling
Your love is stronger than anything
The skies may fade, but you remain
Through every tear
Through every pain
You're the shelter
You're my flame
With your voice it calms my fear
Your peace is always near
Your love is stronger than anything
Your name it makes the heavens sing
Yahushua, my heart will cling
Your love is stronger than anything
Thank you.
